cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Delegate Downward
cards.instruction: Make someone accept an unwanted responsibility by placing them lower in the hierarchy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're my deputy, so you'll answer the inspector's complaints. I'll stay at the decision-making level.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're complaints about decisions you made.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And you'll have my notes. Use your own wording for the replies; deputies handle the detailed explanation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The signer has to attend tomorrow's hearing. I'm not facing it alone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll come and supply any facts you need. You sign and speak as deputy; I'll be there as your superior. Choose where I sit so you can turn to me. We can keep the hierarchy clear and work together.

reason: Have A offer notes and attendance support to secure B acceptance of subordinate complaint representation while retaining the rank-based transfer of unwelcome responsibility.
